ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black central region occupying approximately 60% of the fluke surface, contrasted with high-intensity white lateral lobes occupying approximately 40%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black mass extending from the peduncle attachment to the trailing edge. High-intensity white fields located on the distal half of both lobes. Fine-grained dark punctate mottling distributed across the white lateral fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, obtuse V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 145 degrees and minimal vertical depth relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated profile along the entire trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude pixel variations (peaks and valleys). Serrations are more jagged and pronounced on the lateral section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark punctate clusters on the white lateral lobe surfaces. Significant multi-tonal, high-intensity clusters at the extreme distal tips suggesting calcified barnacle growth.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of fine, high-intensity white linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the black central pigment, oriented primarily in a diagonal pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white linear rake mark scarring across the central dark region; significant calcified accumulations (likely barnacles) on the lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pattern of small, isolated dark circular spots on the ventral surface of the far-left white lobe field.
